caption: When Jesus says “I am,” is he using God’s name? Perhaps—but Exodus reveals God’s identity to Moses. It does not predict a future saviour.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Jesus use God’s name? God tells Moses, “I AM WHO I AM.” Jesus later says, “Before Abraham was born, I am.” Christians hear an echo of God’s name.
slides.body: God tells Moses, “I AM WHO I AM.” Jesus later says, “Before Abraham was born, I am.” Christians hear an echo of God’s name.
slides.heading: Did Jesus use God’s name?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Exod 3:13-15: I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’
slides.body: I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’
slides.heading: Exod 3:13-15

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Jn 8:58, BSB: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
slides.body: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Jn 8:58

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Why Christians connect them Jesus contrasts his existence with Abraham’s, and his listeners try to stone him. That makes the statement sound like a bold claim to share God’s identity.
slides.body: Jesus contrasts his existence with Abraham’s, and his listeners try to stone him. That makes the statement sound like a bold claim to share God’s identity.
slides.heading: Why Christians connect them

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But Exodus is not predicting Jesus Exodus reveals God’s name during Moses’s story. It says nothing about a future saviour. Jesus may echo this or other passages, but that is a later claim about his identity—not an Exodus prediction.
slides.body: Exodus reveals God’s name during Moses’s story. It says nothing about a future saviour. Jesus may echo this or other passages, but that is a later claim about his identity—not an Exodus prediction.
slides.heading: But Exodus is not predicting Jesus

title: The great ‘I AM’
